title: “Why me, ma'am? Because you're the best of what's left.”
body:
The title is a quote from the film ‘Hot Shots! Part Deux’ and it’s a good description of Google Tasks.
Google’s developers: “Relying on this to remind you of important things to do? We hope you don’t mind we haven’t added support for badges. And sorry you have to delete all completed tasks to see those that will repeat. 😂“
author: abubasim

title: Tags or labels needed!
body: I like the Google tasks app but there is one more feature that I need badly and make me look around for other todo apps. Labels or tags, which is available in other Google apps such as “keep”, is the one feature I think will make a big difference.
